On the other hand, when I'm at home, strangely enough, I feel more at ease, even if I'm alone. So, I guess that's a bit more complex. Traveling on public transport? That can really ramp up my anxiety too. It's a mixed bag, but mostly, those scenarios do make me feel anxious.
